name: AlertScriptsPath
description: Location of custom alert scripts (depends on compile-time installation variable datadir).

name: AllowRoot
description:
Allow the server to run as 'root'. If disabled and the server is started by 'root', the server will try to switch to the 'zabbix' user instead. Has no effect if started under a regular user.
0 - do not allow
1 - allow
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 2.2.0.

name: CacheSize
description:
Size of configuration cache, in bytes.
Shared memory size for storing host, item and trigger data.
The maximum value of this parameter was increased from 8GB to 64GB in Zabbix 4.0.21.

name: CacheUpdateFrequency
description:
How often Zabbix will perform update of configuration cache, in seconds.
See also runtime control options.

name: DBHost
description:
Database host name.
In case of MySQL localhost or empty string results in using a socket. In case of PostgreSQL
only empty string results in attempt to use socket.

name: DBName
description: Database name.

name: DBPassword
description:
Database password.
Comment this line if no password is used.

name: DBPort
description: Database port when not using local socket.

name: DBSchema
description: Schema name. Used for IBM DB2 and PostgreSQL.

name: DBSocket
description: Path to MySQL socket file.

name: DBUser
description: Database user.

name: DebugLevel
description:
Specifies debug level:
0 - basic information about starting and stopping of Zabbix processes
1 - critical information
2 - error information
3 - warnings
4 - for debugging (produces lots of information)
5 - extended debugging (produces even more information)
See also runtime control options.

name: ExportDir
description:
Directory for real-time export of events, history and trends in newline-delimited JSON format. If set, enables real-time export.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 4.0.0.

name: ExportFileSize
description:
Maximum size per export file in bytes. Only used for rotation if ExportDir is set.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 4.0.0.

name: ExternalScripts
description: Location of external scripts (depends on compile-time installation variable datadir).

name: Fping6Location
description:
Location of fping6.
Make sure that fping6 binary has root ownership and SUID flag set.
Make empty ("Fping6Location=") if your fping utility is capable to process IPv6 addresses.

name: FpingLocation
description:
Location of fping.
Make sure that fping binary has root ownership and SUID flag set!

name: HistoryCacheSize
description:
Size of history cache, in bytes.
Shared memory size for storing history data.

name: HistoryIndexCacheSize
description:
Size of history index cache, in bytes.
Shared memory size for indexing history data stored in history cache.
The index cache size needs roughly 100 bytes to cache one item.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 3.0.0.

name: HistoryStorageDateIndex
description:
Enable preprocessing of history values in history storage to store values in different indices based on date:
0 - disable
1 - enable

name: HistoryStorageURL
description:
History storage HTTP[S] URL.
This parameter is used for Elasticsearch setup.

name: HistoryStorageTypes
description:
Comma separated list of value types to be sent to the history storage.
This parameter is used for Elasticsearch setup.

name: HousekeepingFrequency
description:
How often Zabbix will perform housekeeping procedure (in hours).
Housekeeping is removing outdated information from the database.
Note: To prevent housekeeper from being overloaded (for example, when history and trend periods are greatly reduced), no more than 4 times HousekeepingFrequency hours of outdated information are deleted in one housekeeping cycle, for each item. Thus, if HousekeepingFrequency is 1, no more than 4 hours of outdated information (starting from the oldest entry) will be deleted per cycle.
Note: To lower load on server startup housekeeping is postponed for 30 minutes after server start. Thus, if HousekeepingFrequency is 1, the very first housekeeping procedure after server start will run after 30 minutes, and will repeat with one hour delay thereafter. This postponing behavior is in place since Zabbix 2.4.0.
Since Zabbix 3.0.0 it is possible to disable automatic housekeeping by setting HousekeepingFrequency to 0. In this case the housekeeping procedure can only be started by housekeeper_execute runtime control option and the period of outdated information deleted in one housekeeping cycle is 4 times the period since the last housekeeping cycle, but not less than 4 hours and not greater than 4 days.
See also runtime control options.

name: Include
description:
You may include individual files or all files in a directory in the configuration file.
To only include relevant files in the specified directory, the asterisk wildcard character is supported for pattern matching. For example: /absolute/path/to/config/files/*.conf. Pattern matching is supported since Zabbix 2.4.0.
See special notes about limitations.

name: JavaGateway
description:
IP address (or hostname) of Zabbix Java gateway.
Only required if Java pollers are started.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 2.0.0.

name: JavaGatewayPort
description:
Port that Zabbix Java gateway listens on.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 2.0.0.

name: ListenIP
description:
List of comma delimited IP addresses that the trapper should listen on.
Trapper will listen on all network interfaces if this parameter is missing.
Multiple IP addresses are supported since Zabbix 1.8.3.

name: ListenPort
description: Listen port for trapper.

name: LoadModule
description:
Module to load at server startup. Modules are used to extend functionality of the server.
Formats:
LoadModule=<module.so>
LoadModule=<path/module.so>
(since 4.0.9) LoadModule=</abs_path/module.so>
Either the module must be located in directory specified by LoadModulePath or (since 4.0.9) the path must precede the module name. If the preceding path is absolute (starts with '/') then LoadModulePath is ignored.
It is allowed to include multiple LoadModule parameters.

name: LoadModulePath
description:
Full path to location of server modules.
Default depends on compilation options.

name: LogFile
mandatory:
yes, if LogType is set to file, otherwise
no
description: Name of log file.

name: LogFileSize
description:
Maximum size of log file in MB.
0 - disable automatic log rotation.
Note: If the log file size limit is reached and file rotation fails, for whatever reason, the existing log file is truncated and started anew.

name: LogType
description:
Log output type:
file - write log to file specified by LogFile parameter,
system - write log to syslog,
console - write log to standard output.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 3.0.0.

name: LogSlowQueries
description:
How long a database query may take before being logged (in milliseconds).
0 - don't log slow queries.
This option becomes enabled starting with DebugLevel=3.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 1.8.2.

name: MaxHousekeeperDelete
description:
No more than 'MaxHousekeeperDelete' rows (corresponding to [tablename], [field], [value]) will be deleted per one task in one housekeeping cycle.
If set to 0 then no limit is used at all. In this case you must know what you are doing, so as not to overload the database! 2
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 1.8.2 and applies only to deleting history and trends of already deleted items.

name: PidFile
description: Name of PID file.

name: ProxyConfigFrequency
description:
How often Zabbix server sends configuration data to a Zabbix proxy in seconds. Used only for proxies in a passive mode.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 1.8.3.

name: ProxyDataFrequency
description:
How often Zabbix server requests history data from a Zabbix proxy in seconds. Used only for proxies in a passive mode.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 1.8.3.

name: SNMPTrapperFile
description:
Temporary file used for passing data from SNMP trap daemon to the server.
Must be the same as in zabbix_trap_receiver.pl or SNMPTT configuration file.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 2.0.0.

name: SocketDir
description:
Directory to store IPC sockets used by internal Zabbix services.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 3.4.0.

name: SourceIP
description:
Source IP address for:
- outgoing connections to Zabbix proxy and Zabbix agent;
- agentless connections (VMware, SSH, JMX, SNMP, Telnet and simple checks);
- HTTP agent connections;
- sending notification emails (connections to SMTP server)

name: SSHKeyLocation
description: Location of public and private keys for SSH checks and actions

name: SSLCertLocation
description:
Location of SSL client certificate files for client authentication.
This parameter is used in web monitoring only and is supported since Zabbix 2.4.

name: SSLKeyLocation
description:
Location of SSL private key files for client authentication.
This parameter is used in web monitoring only and is supported since Zabbix 2.4.

name: SSLCALocation
description:
Override the location of certificate authority (CA) files for SSL server certificate verification. If not set, system-wide directory will be used.
Note that the value of this parameter will be set as libcurl option CURLOPT_CAPATH. For libcurl versions before 7.42.0, this only has effect if libcurl was compiled to use OpenSSL. For more information see cURL web page.
This parameter is used in web monitoring since Zabbix 2.4.0 and in SMTP authentication since Zabbix 3.0.0.

name: StartDBSyncers
description:
Number of pre-forked instances of DB Syncers.
The upper limit used to be 64 before version 1.8.5.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 1.8.3.

name: StartAlerters
description:
Number of pre-forked instances of alerters.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 3.4.0.

name: StartDiscoverers
description:
Number of pre-forked instances of discoverers.
The upper limit used to be 255 before version 1.8.5.

name: StartEscalators
description:
Number of pre-forked instances of escalators.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 3.0.0.

name: StartHTTPPollers
description:
Number of pre-forked instances of HTTP pollers1.
The upper limit used to be 255 before version 1.8.5.

name: StartIPMIPollers
description:
Number of pre-forked instances of IPMI pollers.
The upper limit used to be 255 before version 1.8.5.

name: StartJavaPollers
description:
Number of pre-forked instances of Java pollers1.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 2.0.0.

name: StartPingers
description:
Number of pre-forked instances of ICMP pingers1.
The upper limit used to be 255 before version 1.8.5.

name: StartPollersUnreachable
description:
Number of pre-forked instances of pollers for unreachable hosts (including IPMI and Java)1.
Since Zabbix 2.4.0, at least one poller for unreachable hosts must be running if regular, IPMI or Java pollers are started.
The upper limit used to be 255 before version 1.8.5.
This option is missing in version 1.8.3.

name: StartPollers
description:
Number of pre-forked instances of pollers1.
Note that a non-zero value is required for internal, aggregated and calculated items to work.

name: StartPreprocessors
description:
Number of pre-forked instances of preprocessing workers1.
The preprocessing manager process is automatically started when a preprocessor worker is started.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 3.4.0.

name: StartProxyPollers
description:
Number of pre-forked instances of pollers for passive proxies1.
The upper limit used to be 255 before version 1.8.5.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 1.8.3.

name: StartSNMPTrapper
description:
If set to 1, SNMP trapper process will be started.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 2.0.0.

name: StartTimers
description:
Number of pre-forked instances of timers.
Timers process maintenance periods.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 2.2.0.

name: StartTrappers
description:
Number of pre-forked instances of trappers1.
Trappers accept incoming connections from Zabbix sender, active agents and active proxies.
At least one trapper process must be running to display server availability and view queue in the frontend.
The upper limit used to be 255 before version 1.8.5.

name: StartVMwareCollectors
description:
Number of pre-forked vmware collector instances.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 2.2.0.

name: StatsAllowedIP
description:
List of comma delimited IP addresses, optionally in CIDR notation, or DNS names of external Zabbix instances. Stats request will be accepted only from the addresses listed here. If this parameter is not set no stats requests will be accepted.
If IPv6 support is enabled then '127.0.0.1', '::127.0.0.1', '::ffff:127.0.0.1' are treated equally and '::/0' will allow any IPv4 or IPv6 address. '0.0.0.0/0' can be used to allow any IPv4 address.
Example: StatsAllowedIP=127.0.0.1,192.168.1.0/24,::1,2001:db8::/32,zabbix.example.com
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 4.0.5.

name: Timeout
description: Specifies how long we wait for agent, SNMP device or external check (in seconds).

name: TLSCAFile
description:
Full pathname of a file containing the top-level CA(s) certificates for peer certificate verification, used for encrypted communications between Zabbix components.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 3.0.0.

name: TLSCertFile
description:
Full pathname of a file containing the server certificate or certificate chain, used for encrypted communications between Zabbix components.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 3.0.0.

name: TLSCipherAll
description:
GnuTLS priority string or OpenSSL (TLS 1.2) cipher string. Override the default ciphersuite selection criteria for certificate- and PSK-based encryption.
Example: TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256:TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 4.0.19.

name: TLSCipherAll13
description:
Cipher string for OpenSSL 1.1.1 or newer in TLS 1.3. Override the default ciphersuite selection criteria for certificate- and PSK-based encryption.
Example for GnuTLS: NONE:+VERS-TLS1.2:+ECDHE-RSA:+RSA:+ECDHE-PSK:+PSK:+AES-128-GCM:+AES-128-CBC:+AEAD:+SHA256:+SHA1:+CURVE-ALL:+COMP-NULL::+SIGN-ALL:+CTYPE-X.509
Example for OpenSSL: EECDH+aRSA+AES128:RSA+aRSA+AES128:kECDHEPSK+AES128:kPSK+AES128
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 4.0.19.

name: TLSCipherCert
description:
GnuTLS priority string or OpenSSL (TLS 1.2) cipher string. Override the default ciphersuite selection criteria for certificate-based encryption.
Example for GnuTLS: NONE:+VERS-TLS1.2:+ECDHE-RSA:+RSA:+AES-128-GCM:+AES-128-CBC:+AEAD:+SHA256:+SHA1:+CURVE-ALL:+COMP-NULL:+SIGN-ALL:+CTYPE-X.509
Example for OpenSSL: EECDH+aRSA+AES128:RSA+aRSA+AES128
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 4.0.19.

name: TLSCipherCert13
description:
Cipher string for OpenSSL 1.1.1 or newer in TLS 1.3. Override the default ciphersuite selection criteria for certificate-based encryption.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 4.0.19.

name: TLSCipherPSK
description:
GnuTLS priority string or OpenSSL (TLS 1.2) cipher string. Override the default ciphersuite selection criteria for PSK-based encryption.
Example for GnuTLS: NONE:+VERS-TLS1.2:+ECDHE-PSK:+PSK:+AES-128-GCM:+AES-128-CBC:+AEAD:+SHA256:+SHA1:+CURVE-ALL:+COMP-NULL:+SIGN-ALL
Example for OpenSSL: kECDHEPSK+AES128:kPSK+AES128
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 4.0.19.

name: TLSCipherPSK13
description:
Cipher string for OpenSSL 1.1.1 or newer in TLS 1.3. Override the default ciphersuite selection criteria for PSK-based encryption.
Example: TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256:TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 4.0.19.

name: TLSCRLFile
description:
Full pathname of a file containing revoked certificates. This parameter is used for encrypted communications between Zabbix components.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 3.0.0.

name: TLSKeyFile
description:
Full pathname of a file containing the server private key, used for encrypted communications between Zabbix components.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 3.0.0.

name: TmpDir
description: Temporary directory.

name: TrapperTimeout
description: Specifies how many seconds trapper may spend processing new data.

name: TrendCacheSize
description:
Size of trend cache, in bytes.
Shared memory size for storing trends data.

name: UnavailableDelay
description: How often host is checked for availability during the unavailability period, in seconds.

name: UnreachableDelay
description: How often host is checked for availability during the unreachability period, in seconds.

name: UnreachablePeriod
description: After how many seconds of unreachability treat a host as unavailable.

name: User
description:
Drop privileges to a specific, existing user on the system.
Only has effect if run as 'root' and AllowRoot is disabled.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 2.4.0.

name: ValueCacheSize
description:
Size of history value cache, in bytes.
Shared memory size for caching item history data requests.
Setting to 0 disables value cache (not recommended).
When value cache runs out of the shared memory a warning message is written to the server log every 5 minutes.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 2.2.0.

name: VMwareCacheSize
description:
Shared memory size for storing VMware data.
A VMware internal check zabbix[vmware,buffer,...] can be used to monitor the VMware cache usage (see Internal checks).
Note that shared memory is not allocated if there are no vmware collector instances configured to start.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 2.2.0.

name: VMwareFrequency
description:
Delay in seconds between data gathering from a single VMware service.
This delay should be set to the least update interval of any VMware monitoring item.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 2.2.0.

name: VMwarePerfFrequency
description:
Delay in seconds between performance counter statistics retrieval from a single VMware service.
This delay should be set to the least update interval of any VMware monitoring item that uses VMware performance counters.
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 2.2.9, 2.4.4

name: VMwareTimeout
description:
The maximum number of seconds vmware collector will wait for a response from VMware service (vCenter or ESX hypervisor).
This parameter is supported since Zabbix 2.2.9, 2.4.4
